title: DarkMusic 1.5.0 Release
changelog:
• Default 4:3 aspect ratio across Song Share & Lyrics Share (photo cards & animated videos)
• Fixed audio distortion in lyrics MP4 videos for Opus/cloud streaming songs (e.g. Espresso) with native 32-bit float PCM to 16-bit studio pipeline
• Guaranteed title and artist boundary fitting: long song titles never overflow screen
• Removed Lossless Audio tag for ultra-clean luxury card aesthetics
releaseNotes: v1.5.2: Removed lyrics from song share, 3-line rolling lyrics in video, authentic DarkMusic logo, persistent song retention across app switch/reopen, eliminated Play Protect scan, dynamic cover-art adaptive theme, and fixed MP4 audio 0.5x reverb bug.
